ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The one who knows the rule is wary because genuine discernment makes the danger of a move visible; the phrase marks precision, not timidity.
EvidenceBody: Dahui places the warning beside the command-sword and elsewhere beside finding the turning path; Hongzhi applies it to distinguishing a viable response from self-defeat.
